Title: Document 2
Content: Source: Venustiano Carranza, landowner and major political leader, letter to Emiliano Zapata, Mexico, `text(1914)`.

The owners of large estates have legal rights. It is not possible to take away their property and give it to those who do not have legal title to the property. This land redistribution business is absurd. Tell me which estates you now have control of and wish to redistribute that do not indeed legally belong to someone else.
